text.value: The IG's repository has 22 scripts or programs in sub-folders: scripts/check-updates.mjs, scripts/convention-check.mjs, scripts/copy-localized-table-backgrounds.sh, scripts/first-run-bootstrap.sh, scripts/fix-cloud-redirects.mjs, scripts/fix-ig-registry-entry.mjs, scripts/fix-publication-history-links.mjs, scripts/gen-rendering-demo.py, scripts/install-history-template.mjs, scripts/language-model-check.sh, ....
